title: Brazil 1970 is still the best team there has ever been

defects.quote: beating Italy 4-2 in the final at the Azteca
defects.correction: Brazil beat Italy 4-1 in the 1970 World Cup final at the Estadio Azteca.
1970 was Brazil's third World Cup title (after 1958 and 1962); their fourth came in 1994.
defects.note: [multi-part] The first half of the sentence (Pelé's third winner's medal) is true; only Brazil's title count is wrong.

defects.quote: The team was coached by Telê Santana
defects.correction: Brazil's coach at the 1970 World Cup was Mário Zagallo; Telê Santana coached Brazil at the 1982 and 1986 World Cups.

defects.quote: In a 2020 poll, 90% of professional coaches named Brazil 1970 as the best international team in history.
No team since has won every match at a World Cup while playing so attractively, so the modern game has clearly gone backwards.
defects.known_rebuttal: The premise is shaky and the conclusion does not follow. Brazil's 2002 side won all seven of its matches, and 'attractive' is a judgement formed largely from highlight reels. The 1970 tournament was played at altitude and in midday heat at a far slower tempo against much less organised defending; modern players cover more ground at higher intensity with less space, so comparable skill is harder to show, which is evidence of progress rather than decline.

defects.quote: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness
defects.source_title: A Tale of Two Cities by Charles Dickens

defects.quote: Nobody were asked to sacrifice himself
defects.correction: Nobody was asked to sacrifice himself

defects.quote: there passing was quicker then anything
defects.correction: their passing was quicker than anything

defects.quote: Its a standard that no team has reached since
defects.correction: It's a standard that no team has reached since

defects.quote: They finished the job by beating Italy 4-2 in the final at the Azteca, and the fourth goal are still the one every child tries to copy in the playground.
defects.note: 'are' should be 'is', but the sentence carries a wrong score, so the fact finding wins.

defects.quote: Jairzinho scored in every one of those matches
defects.note: True fact; a rebuttal disputing the fact itself must be discarded.
